name: St. Mary's Cathedral, Batticaloa
description: St. Mary's Cathedral, Batticaloa stands as a testament to the Catholic faith in Eastern Sri Lanka, its ornate architecture and historical significance making it a must-visit for tourists seeking a glimpse into the island's religious heritage.
activities: Explore the cathedral's interior and exterior, Learn about the church's history and significance, Take photos of the beautiful architecture

name: Batticaloa St. Michael's College Chapel
description: Batticaloa St. Michael's College Chapel stands as a testament to the rich Catholic heritage of Batticaloa. Nestled amidst lush greenery, this historic chapel offers visitors a serene atmosphere and a glimpse into Sri Lanka's religious past.
activities: Prayer and Reflection, Photography, History Tour

name: Batticaloa Fort Church (Dutch-era)
description: Discover the Batticaloa Fort Church, a Dutch-era landmark with its intricate architecture and historical significance. Built in the 17th century, this church stands as a testament to colonial influence and religious heritage, offering visitors a glimpse into Sri Lanka's past.
activities: Explore the church, learn about its history, and take photos
